messages:
Dave PM: FYI — Competitor X released a streaming multimodal chat + a cheaper embedding tier. Team ask: quick product triage for feature parity risk and what to pull forward this quarter.

Alicia (product): Noted. Immediate customer perception risk: expectations for cheap embeddings + built-in streaming. We should decide whether to match price or double down on reliability, observability, and enterprise guarantees.

Ben (eng): Price matching is a long play. Engineering can deliver two high-leverage items faster: 1) hosted-only KV/prefix cache to cut redundant tokens, 2) smarter batching + kernel selection to lower per-token compute. Both are nontrivial but hit cost profile directly.

Priyanka (growth): From sales conversations, customers often choose predictable latency and auditability over marginally lower price. If we surface per-route token and latency breakdowns, plus stable model rollouts, we can counter the "lowest price" narrative.

Mike (platform): Rough estimates: KV cache v1 (hosted-only, opt-in) ~6w with 2-3 eng. Batching prototype ~4w. Observability dashboard + prompt harness MVP ~2w. We can sequence to get quick wins.

Sara (design): Observability UI can be lean: per-route token/latency cards, a prompt replay tab, and a brief opt-in control for caching. I can ship mocks in 5 days.

Dave PM: Proposed prioritization:
- Sprint 1 (2w): Observability MVP (dashboard + prompt harness + sales-facing reports)
- Sprint 2 (6w): KV cache v1 hosted-only (opt-in)
- Sprint 3 (6w): Batching/compiler perf work behind feature flag
Does that sequencing look feasible?

Ben (eng): Sequencing OK. Recommend starting KV infra spike week1 in parallel with design so we don't hit a blocker when observability finishes. We'll spike batching ideas during KV work. Need clarity on measurement and cutoffs.

Alicia (product): Launch criteria (public):
- Observability: live per-route token + latency breakdown + prompt harness in Console
- KV cache: >=15% median token reduction on our top-10 replay workloads
- Reliability: no >5% regression in 95th latency across benchmarks
- Quality: zero functional regressions on curated evals
- Docs & Sales: quickstart, migration guide, and two battle cards vs Competitor X

Priyanka (growth): I'll draft the trust-first messaging: "Predictable costs, transparent metrics, enterprise-grade rollouts." Need anonymized benchmark numbers to include.

Mike (platform): I'll build the replay harness and run baseline datasets. ETA: 2w for baseline, then KV-enabled runs + CSV outputs. I'll own anonymization.

Ben (eng): Measurement note: define "median token reduction" as median percent drop in tokens-per-response across the replay set. Also require integration tests ensuring cache correctness and no cross-tenant leakage.

Dave PM: Scope decisions: KV cache v1 is hosted-only and explicitly opt-in; private/VPC support deferred to v2. Batching perf rollout behind feature flag with canary.

Sara (design): UX copy for the cache opt-in: "Enable KV cache to reduce token usage for repeated prompts. Opt-in required to preserve prefix privacy." I'll attach tooltip copy with a short FAQ.

Priyanka (growth): Competitive assets: I want two battle cards — price angle and reliability/SLA angle. We prioritize releasing the SLA/reliability card first. Who provides the benchmark CSVs for collateral?

Mike (platform): Will provide anonymized CSVs from the replay harness. Plan: anonymize customer IDs, provide percent deltas, and include median + 90th percentile improvements.

Ben (eng): If KV cache shows <10% median improvement on baseline, recommendation: deprioritize and shift effort to batching + observability. Need PM decision today.

Alicia (product): Decision: 10% cutoff. If baseline improvement <10%, move KV to backlog and accelerate other initiatives. Documented here for the record.

Dave PM: Action items:
- @Ben (eng): kickoff KV cache infra spike today and own integration tests
- @Mike (platform): deliver replay harness baseline in 2w
- @Sara (design): deliver observability UI mocks by EOW
- @Priyanka (growth): draft messaging + battle cards (first pass in 1w)
- @Alicia/@Dave: update public roadmap and brief sales leads

Ben (eng): Kicking off spike and will post infra notes in thread.

deploy-bot: Reminder: roadmap sync tomorrow 10:30am in #product :calendar:

Priyanka (growth): I'll sync with lead AE before the roadmap sync.

Alicia (product): Good plan. Re-evaluate after baseline runs and adjust scope if needed. :eyes:
